title: The naive framing: "did Claude judge my market?"
text: Someone assumes a finished competitive analysis deck means Claude judged the market itself. It doesn't. The skill just processes a fixed set of steps written in a file. So, does it judge or process? A skill is a folder Claude

title: A skill is a folder
text: Reads before it works. This one is competitive analysis, a skill MD file in a references folder, two files total. The skill MD contains the full instruction set, plain language, no hidden logic. Claude reads it, then acts. The file is the program. The

title: Read, execute, return
text: Pipeline is in the step section. Claude reads skill MD, executes each step in order, and returns the result. Linear, no branching unless a step says so. The skill answers only within what skill MD

title: Only what the file says
text: Specifies. Ask it something inside that scope, a market map, a peer comparison, a positioning assessment, and it runs the same steps every time.
